propositions: newly added hard-fail CI gates lack a grandfather guard for branches created before the gate was added, causing regressions in in-flight branches

rebar's code-review gate has no criterion to detect whether a pipeline/gate-configuration change introduces a hard-fail step or required gate without if-present guards that would break pre-existing branches
code-review project criteria are today dispatched unconditionally without reference to applies_to globs, preventing glob-based gating from working for project-owned criteria

the CI-gate-compat criterion must be portable across CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines, Buildkite, Bitbucket, Drone) by using declarative glob patterns rather than vendor-specific code paths
the applies_to glob set must be project-overridable via a config key so unusual pipelines are declared by projects rather than enumerated in the rebar codebase
